source.operation: GET /rest/api/3/search/jql with `id in (10001)` after issue 10001 moved from ACME-1 to NEW-5 → 200, the issue under its new key
source.note: WP-145 (PROGRESS backlog 437). The JQL fields reference's 'Issue key' section says the field 'Allows searching for issues using their unique identifier or ID number', with syntax `issueKey` and aliases `id`, `issue`, `key`, and the operators `=`, `IN`, `NOT IN` among others — read on the Data Center page because the Cloud page (support.atlassian.com/jira-software-cloud/docs/jql-fields/, cited in SOURCES.md) renders client-side and its text could not be retrieved; that Cloud's search accepts the same is inferred. That a moved issue keeps its id is Atlassian's knowledge base (moved-issues-no-longer-redirect…, SOURCES.md): the former key is joined to the issue's own id. So `id in (10001)` answering the issue as NEW-5 is inferred from the two, not recorded. The envelope is search-jql.json's (the swagger's documented example); the issue is issue-acme-1.json's id under the moved key. Not measured on a Cloud site: docs/TODO.md's WP-145 row.
